body:
The same departed participant gets different "Former member N" numbers depending on the screen.

- Web form: `labelFor` in ExpenseDialog.tsx uses `participantIds.indexOf(id) + 1`, which counts current members first. Reproduced: list rows and balances say "Former member 1", the form says "Former member 3" on a 2-member list.
- Android form: `rowsFor` in ExpenseFormViewModel.kt calls `formerMemberNumbers(listOfNotNull(loaded), ...)`, numbering within the single loaded expense; ExpenseListViewModel numbers across all expenses. With two former members the form can call the second one "1".
- Both list/balances screens agree with each other (formerMemberNumbers across sorted expenses).

Fix: pass the list-wide numbering into the form on both clients (web: prop from the page; Android: from the list's expenses or a shared helper), and remove the local numbering. Pin with a screen test on each client.

Design note to weigh while here: numbering is by first appearance in newest-first order, so adding a newer expense that involves a different former member renumbers everyone. Stable would be by first appearance in oldest-first or by account id. Both clients would need the same rule (shared-test-cases).
title: Former members are numbered differently in the expense form than on the list and balances, both clients
